thread:
Aisha R.: Hi team! First week here — thanks for the warm welcome earlier. My monitor shipment arrived but the dock power LED is amber and only one of the two DP ports sends a signal. Also when I try to join CompanyCorp (802.1X) my Mac prompts for an "identity certificate" and won't let me in. Opened ticket IT-4891. Any quick checks?

Nate (IT): welcome Aisha :wave: Quick q's: 1) which dock model (label underside)? 2) does the amber LED blink or steady? 3) can you try a different DP cable if you have one? Also paste output of `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` and `ifconfig | grep en` if handy.

Aisha R.: Dock label: "Triton Pro Dock-USB4" S/N TRN-00421. LED is steady amber (not blinking). I only got one DP cable in the box. Outputs (redacted):
```
$ system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType
Display:
  Connection Type: DisplayPort
  Vendor: Generic
  Resolution: 2560 x 1440
```
```
$ ifconfig | grep en
en0: flags=8863<UP,BROADCAST,SMART,RUNNING,SIMPLEX,MULTICAST> mtu 1500
```
It shows en0 up but I don't see an external USB-Ethernet entry.

Samir K.: Amber steady often means power negotiation limited to a fallback 15W rail on these Triton units. With that power some ports (esp second DP) won't enumerate. Two likely fixes: a proper USB-C PD cable that supports full USB4 PD table, or a firmware provisioning step.

Priya S.: I hit this last month — the first DP port worked but the second didn't until IT swapped cable. We had a bad batch of passive DP++ cables. Nate, do we still have short active DP cables in stock for loan?

Nate (IT): We do. Option A: we ship an active DP cable + high-power USB-C cable; option B: bring system to office for quick bench test. For 802.1X cert: sounds like your machine hasn't pulled the device cert from Okta device mgmt. Go to Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll Device and then Networking -> Install 802.1X cert. If that fails, Samir can push the cert to the device once we verify your device id.

Aisha R.: I'm remote in NYC, so shipping is best. Could you also include a short USB-Ethernet dongle? I need wired for a VPN setup today.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4891 created by Aisha R.: "Triton Pro Dock amber LED, DP2 no signal, 802.1X cert missing." Priority: P2.

Nate (IT): All set, Aisha — I've attached a shipping request. Outbound kit: 1x Active DP cable (30cm), 1x USB-C 100W certified cable, 1x USB 3.0 Ethernet dongle. Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1Z888BB20234567890 ETA 2 business days.

Samir K.: If the cable swap doesn't fix DP2, we can schedule a remote flash of Triton v2.14 firmware. That requires running our helper script `triton-fw-flash.sh` from Recovery (we'll provide step-by-step). Re 802.1X: before shipping I'll trigger a device enrollment token for you so Self-Service enrollment is one-click.

Aisha R.: Thanks! Will try the Self-Service flow once the token arrives. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Priya S.: welcome again and ping me if you want a quick onboarding tour once setup is done :slightly_smiling_face: 

Nate (IT): Ticket updated: shipping kits + device enrollment token pending. Please re-open or DM if anything changes.

Aisha R.: Perfect — thanks team :sparkles: I'll update once the kit arrives and I test DP2 and Wi-Fi.
